kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Australian social media users to be offered choice to opt out of algorithms
wire.summary: A government statement said on Tuesday social media platforms would be required to send a notification to new and existing users offering them a choice over their default feed.

wire.title: U.K. accuses Israeli settlers of 'ethnic cleansing' in West Bank and bans their goods
wire.summary: France, Canada and other countries joined the U.K. in banning goods from Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. Israel said it would close the British Consulate among other measures.

wire.title: Whatever happened to the Taliban threat: 'We will flog the women'?
wire.summary: In 2024, the ruling Taliban pledged to use flogging as well as stoning to punish people for not following certain of their precepts — committing adultery, running secret schools for girls. Have they followed through?

wire.title: GOP to host unusual midterm convention. And, Canada's retaliatory tariffs take effect
wire.summary: Republicans are aiming to get voters to turn out for the midterms with an unconventional convention. And, Canada's retaliatory tariffs on the U.S. went into effect at midnight.

wire.title: Chrystia Freeland negotiated with Trump. Now she's watching a trade war unfold
wire.summary: Chrystia Freeland understands the U.S.-Canada relationship from her time at the negotiating table. Here's what she sees now.

wire.title: Has the economy gone C-shaped?
wire.summary: A K means the rich and poor are pulling apart. A C supposedly means they're coming back together. We hear the case for both. Which letter you see may depend on what you choose to pay attention to.

wire.title: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia ignite fires at oil facilities and wound 73 people
wire.summary: The attacks come after weeks of escalating clashes between the Houthis and Saudi-backed government forces in Yemen, which shattered a four-year truce in the country's civil war.

wire.title: The 2026 midterm general election season is upon us. Here's what to watch
wire.summary: The week of Labor Day marks the unofficial kickoff of the general election season. President Trump's unpopularity and Democratic enthusiasm means control of Congress is on the ballot.

wire.title: 60 years later, 'Star Trek' continues to 'live long and prosper'
wire.summary: The television series 'Star Trek' turns 60 on Tuesday. The original show aired for only three seasons, but it spawned prequels and sequels (on TV and in theaters) and still has a cult following.

wire.title: What to know about Canada's escalating trade war with the U.S.
wire.summary: Canada struck back at U.S. President Donald Trump on Tuesday with tariffs on about $20 billion worth of U.S. goods. The outcome could resonate far beyond Canada.

wire.title: Carney says US trade war 'will come at a cost' as Canada strikes back on tariffs
wire.summary: Canada's levies - as high as 50% - will apply to nearly $20bn of US products, from steel to T-shirts.

wire.title: Renoir paintings worth millions stolen in French museum heist
wire.summary: It is the latest in a string of high-profile art thefts in Europe that has again put the security of museums and galleries in the spotlight.

wire.title: Argentina to file criminal case against oil company operating in Falklands
wire.summary: The move comes days after President Javier Milei stepped up Argentina's claims of sovereignty over the Falklands.

wire.title: Ukrainian TV channel building hit by Russian drone as five killed in Kyiv
wire.summary: President Zelensky describes the daytime drone attack in Ukraine's capital as a "new page in Russian degradation"

wire.title: British widow faces deportation from Sweden after 22 years
wire.summary: A 78-year-old British woman is facing deportation for failing to fill out a Brexit residence application on time.

wire.title: Saudi Arabia vows to respond after Houthis attack cities and energy facilities
wire.summary: The Iran-backed Yemeni group's attacks have injured 73 people and caused fires at oil facilities, Saudi authorities say.
